title: Controlled source packet: domain and evidence brief
excerpt: The proposed glacier study uses optical imagery from two summer visits. Cloud-covered pixels are unavailable observations, not ice-free terrain. A local inventory supplies glacier outlines but does not establish recent retreat. No field measurements have been collected for this proposal.

title: Controlled source packet: experimental design brief
excerpt: A boundary model will receive the same image pairs in both conditions. The comparison is between mandatory classification and an abstention rule for cloud-covered pixels. The evaluation set will contain 24 image pairs. The study will not estimate annual retreat rates.
